body.x: EyeQue unveiled ‘EyeQue Personal Vision Tracker' at ‘CES 2017 Unveiled’ which is held in Las Vegas from January 5th to 8th.

EyeQue Personal Vision Tracker is a personal vision test device which works by a smartphone. Its exclusive application ‘myEyeQue’ controls the mini-scope. Users can examine their vision, following its instruction.

The result is saved in EyeQue cloud in real time. Users can check sphericity, circumference and astimometer degree of their eyes which are needed to make lens or glasses. It features that users can simply understand the change of vision. In U.S. there are online glasses stores which can make glasses with users’ vision test results.
